skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand general theoretical issues about human rights in modern legal science development.
Understand basic legal knowledge about human rights in international law.
Understand and apply basic legal knowledge about human rights in Vietnamese law.
Understand mechanisms for protecting human rights and apply them to solve practical issues in Vietnam.
Apply communication, presentation, and public speaking skills effectively.
Develop the ability to independently research, accumulate, and enhance knowledge.
Be proactive in presenting research results.
